model_inference: none; actual Pi host executes local Shiori slash commands in RPC mode
boundary: The Pi SDK host, extension loader, extension lifecycle and Shiori commands are real. The deterministic smoke skill is filesystem input; no provider/model call or mocked host is used. Pi settings, home and temp paths are isolated and removed after the checks.

cases.name: happy_path
cases.command: npm run smoke:pi (actual locally pinned Pi RPC host and Shiori extension)

assertions.expected: Pi handles Shiori's interactive recommendation command and the real extension returns its discovered smoke-skill.

cases.name: error_path
cases.command: npm run smoke:pi (actual locally pinned Pi RPC host and Shiori extension)

assertions.expected: Cancelling Shiori's actual RPC input dialog is handled with its cancellation notice and no model call.

cases.name: reload_cleanup
cases.command: npm run smoke:pi (actual locally pinned Pi RPC host and Shiori extension)

assertions.expected: Runtime reload re-registers Shiori and resets its session-local inventory counter to the single new session_start refresh.
A second actual Pi process registers Shiori again after the first process shuts down.
The second process handles Shiori's interactive recommendation and returns the discovered skill.
Both actual Pi processes exit with status 0 and emit no unhandled or shutdown errors.

cases.name: host_shell
cases.command: npm run smoke:pi (native host shell launches the locally pinned Pi CLI)

assertions.expected: The native host shell launches the locally pinned Pi CLI and returns exactly its SDK version.
